card.name: Words leading into household objects and tools
card.fires_on: Linking words (such as other, of, a, -containing) right before a list or phrase naming physical objects, such as zinc items, knives, scissors, needles or pads.

modes.label: Object lists
modes.description: Words like other or a comma inside a list of household items.
modes.example: Make certain knives, scissors, and<< other>> sharp utensils are out of reach.

modes.label: Before a named object
modes.description: A small word just before a specific item or tool is named.
modes.example: Who got stabbed with<< a>> kitchen knife?

modes.label: Zinc sources
modes.description: Words after zinc leading to the objects that contain it.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before the text names an everyday object or tool.
